why: Joins a human has read twice. Each entry carries its reason; a record that does not exist stops the build; a join that would make anyone their own ancestor is refused. See the comment in tools/build_people.py.

joins.head: crescenzo-rivetti-angela-falco|Angela Falco
joins.reason: The widow's own death row names her parents as Matteo Falco and Francesca Crisci; she died 17 Oct 1822.

joins.head: arcangelo-crisci-anna-falco|Anna Falco
joins.reason: The wife's death row names Pasquale Falco and Chiara Rivetti as her parents; she died 23 Aug 1820.

joins.head: carmine-annecchino-rosa-ceglia|Carmine Annecchino (of Antonio, d. 1838)
joins.reason: The husband's death row names Antonio Annecchino and Maria Guida as his parents; he died 8 Aug 1838.

joins.head: carmine-rivetti-giustina-morgillo|Carmine Rivetti
joins.reason: One act, two households: the child's death row reads «marito di Giustina Morgillo»; he died 15 Sep 1821.

joins.head: raffaele-crisci-francesca-falco|Francesca Falco
joins.reason: The wife's death row names Giuseppe Falco and Antonia di Guida as her parents; she died 8 Jun 1876.

joins.head: aniello-crisci-giovanna-falco|Giovanna Falco
joins.reason: The wife's death row names Giuseppe Falco and Antonia di Guida as her parents; she died 14 Oct 1872.

joins.head: giuseppe-falco-rosa-zimbardo|Giuseppe Falco (of Rosa Zimbardo)
joins.reason: Morti 1882, act 34: «dal fu Vincenzo … e dalla fu Andreana Crisci … marito di Rosa Zimbardo»; he died 3 May 1882.

joins.head: francesco-quotolo-maria-falco|Maria Falco
joins.reason: One act, two households: «figlia delli fu Giuseppe Falco e Rosa Sossi, vedova di Francesco Quotolo»; she died 24 Jul 1817.

joins.head: alfonso-diglio-maria-falco|Maria Falco
joins.reason: The wife's death row names Pasquale Falco and Chiara Rivetti as her parents; she died 25 Apr 1826.

joins.head: pasquale-falco-maria-amalia-guida|Pasquale Falco
joins.reason: Morti 1883, act 60: «dal fu Francesco … e dalla fu Raffaela Falco … marito di Maria Amalia Guido»; he died 26 Sep 1883.

The tree's Carmine is the father of the tree's Filomena and Giacomo; the register's Carmine heads the household whose children include that Filomena (already joined) and a Giacomo. The tree carries no dates, so nothing could be counted.

joins.head: carmine-annecchino-rosa-ceglia|Carmine Annecchino (of Antonio, d. 1838)
joins.reason: Both rows carry the same death act (Forchia Morti 1838 act 20, 8 Aug 1838): he is the «grandfather» named in his son Sabatino's marriage dossier of 1860, whose papers include that extract.

joins.head: luigi-falco-carolina-cimmino|Luigi Falco (of Carolina Cimmino)
joins.reason: Born 21 Dec 1819 to Vincenzo Falco and Andreana Crisci; married Carolina Cimmino of the Capodiconca on 13 Aug 1851; died 16 Dec 1864 «marito di Carolina Cimmino». The Nati of 1858, 1859 and 1862 name a Luigi Falco, contadino, whose wife is Carolina Cimmino of the Capodiconca — the same wife, the same street, the right age. The join rests on the wife and the street, not on the forename.

joins.head: stanislao-falco-filomena-di-lucia|Stanislao Falco (of Filomena di Lucia)
joins.reason: Nati 1864, act 16: «STANISLAO FALCO figlio di Vincenzo, di anni ventiquattro … sartore … da Filomena di Lucia sua moglie» — the filiation, the age (24, as at his marriage of 19 Sep 1861) and the wife's name agree with the household's Stanislao, born 9 Sep 1838.

joins.head: andrea-falco-maria-carmela-buono|Andrea Falco (of Maria Carmela Buono)
joins.reason: The household's Andrea married Maria Carmela Buono on 24 May 1846 (civil; church 21 May); the Nati of 1857 and 1861 name an Andrea Falco, calessiere, married to Carmela Bruno/Buono, on the Camellara. The join rests on the husband's and wife's names together; no act yet says «figlio di Vincenzo» of the calessiere himself.

joins.head: antonio-mauro-sara-falco|Sara Falco
joins.reason: Her marriage act of 14 Feb 1855 and her death act of 22 Oct 1886 («moglie di Antonio Mauro», «dal fu Vincenzo … e dalla fu Andreana Crisci»); the Nati of 1858 and 1863 name Sara Falco as the mother of Antonio Mauro's children.

joins.head: angelo-majone-pasqua-falco|Pasqua Falco
joins.reason: Her marriage act of 9 Sep 1856 («Angelo Majone … e Pasqua Falco … figlia di Giuseppe Falco»), and the margin of her own birth act (30 Dec 1880, second marriage to Pasquale Carfora); the Nati of 1858, 1860 and 1864 name Pasqua Falco as the mother of Angelo Majone's children, on the Camellara.

joins.head: raffaele-morgillo-maria-falco|Maria Falco (wife of Raffaele Morgillo)
joins.reason: Her death act of 2 Oct 1871: «Maria Falco, di anni cinquantatre, moglie di Raffaele Morgillo … figlia di Giuseppe e della fu Antonia Guida», Arienzo. The Nati of 1859, 1861 and 1863 name a Maria Falco, forty or thirty-six, wife of a Raffaele Morgillo, colono — the same couple of names in the same town, at the right age (b. c.1818). The join rests on the name pair and the age; no single act names both her parents and her husband.

joins.head: carmine-antonio-falco-giovanna-arricale|Carmine Antonio (Carminantonio) Falco
joins.reason: Nati 1850 act 52: Carmine Antonio, born 10 Jul 1850 to Raffaele Falco and Angela [Rosa] Morgillo of strada Camellara; the margin of his own birth act records his marriage to Giovanna Arricale on 18 Nov 1872 — the marriage of the household's head.

joins.head: giovanbattista-falco-costanza-zimbardo|Giovanbattista Falco (of Corso Caudino)
joins.reason: Nati 1852 act 78: Giovanni Battista, son of Angelo Falco and Maria Cimmino; the margin of his birth act records his marriage to Maria Costanza Zimbardo on 3 Jul 1876 — the household's wife, whose own 1853 birth act carries the same marriage.

joins.head: carmino-falco-giovanna-pellone|Carmino Falco (of Corso Caudino)
joins.reason: Nati 1852 act 9: Carmine, son of Luigi Falco and Carolina Cimmino; the margin of his birth act records his marriage to Giovanna Pellone on 19 Aug 1875 — the household's wife (b. 1855).

joins.head: gioacchino-falco-andreana-crisci|Gioacchino Falco (of via Orticelli)
joins.reason: Nati 1842 act 4: Gioacchino, son of Francesco Falco and Raffaela Falco; the margin of his birth act records his marriage to Andreana Crisci on 16 Nov 1874 — the household of Gioacchino Falco and Andreana Crisci.

joins.head: angelo-falco-annamaria-cimmino-corso-caudino|Angelo Falco (of Corso Caudino)
joins.reason: Arienzo processetto 1847, bundle 3: the civil promise of 29 Mar 1847 names «Angelandrea Falco, figlio di Vincenzo Falco e di Andreana Crisci» marrying Maria Cimmino, and the notarial consents of 1 Mar 1847 name the same groom «Angelo … di Vincenzo e di Andreana Crisci». Maria Cimmino (b. 10 May 1824) is the wife of the Corso Caudino house, whose first child was born 11 months later (Nati 1848 act 10). Settles work-list row 111.

joins.head: angelo-falco-annamaria-cimmino-corso-caudino|Angelo Falco (of Corso Caudino)
joins.reason: Arienzo processetto 1847, bundle 3: the civil promise of 29 Mar 1847 names «Angelandrea Falco, figlio di Vincenzo Falco e di Andreana Crisci» marrying Maria Cimmino, and the notarial consents of 1 Mar 1847 name the same groom «Angelo … di Vincenzo e di Andreana Crisci». Maria Cimmino (b. 10 May 1824) is the wife of the Corso Caudino house, whose first child was born 11 months later (Nati 1848 act 10). Settles work-list row 111.

joins.head: angelo-falco-vincenza-de-lucia|Angelo Falco
joins.reason: Nati 1862 act 35: Angelo, b. 27 Mar 1862 to Crescenzo Falco and Maria Morgillo. The Arienzo births of 1900-1910 name an Angelo Falco, contadino, aged 35 (1900), 37 (1902), 45 (1906) and 48 (1910), husband of Vincenza de Lucia; the family tree gives this Angelo as b. 1862, son of Crescenzo and Maria Morgillo, with a son Crescenzo Francesco — named for his paternal grandfather, as the custom runs. Ages are guesses; no act yet names Angelo's parents.

joins.head: raffaele-falco-costanza-maione|Raffaele Falco
joins.reason: Nati 1873 act 39: Raffaele, b. 6 Apr 1873 to Carminantonio Falco and Giovanna Arricale. The births of 1898 and 1904 name a Raffaele Falco, contadino, aged 25 and 31, husband of Costanza Maione; the family tree gives Raffaele b. 6 Apr 1873 as husband of Constanza Maione. No marriage act has been read for this couple.

joins.head: giovanni-falco-giuseppa-martone|Giovanni Falco (of via Orticelli)
joins.reason: Nati 1850 act 22: Giovanni, b. 5 Mar 1850 to Crescenzo Falco and Maria Morgillo; margin: his marriage of 23 Sep 1877. Matrimoni 1877 act 20 (23 Sep 1877): groom Giovanni Falco, 27, son of Crescenzo and Maria Morgillo, bride Giuseppa Martone — the wife of this household.

joins.head: clemente-falco-gaetana-crispo|Clemente Falco (of Corso Caudino)
joins.reason: Nati 1858 act 31: Clemente, b. 28 Feb 1858 to Angelo Falco and Maria Cimmino; margin: his marriage of 21 Jun 1880. Matrimoni 1880 act 9 (21 Jun 1880): groom Clemente Falco, 22, son of Angelo and Maria Cimmino, bride Maria Clementina Gaetana Crispo — the wife of this household.
